traceability.evidence:
Implementation and tests for 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are present and wired into the plugin:
1) Core rule implementation - File: src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts - Top-level JSDoc explicitly ties this rule to the story and its requirements: /** * Rule to validate @story and @req annotation format and syntax... * @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md * @story docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md * @req REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION - Define clear format rules for @story and @req annotations * @req REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION - Validate annotation syntax matches specification * @req REQ-PATH-FORMAT - Validate @story paths follow expected patterns * @req REQ-REQ-FORMAT - Validate @req identifiers follow expected patterns * @req REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT - Handle annotations split across multiple lines * @req REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING - Support reasonable variations in whitespace and formatting * @req REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY - Provide specific error messages for different format violations */ - The rule implements all the specified behaviors: - REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION / REQ-PATH-FORMAT: - STORY paths are validated via: const pathPattern = /^docs\/stories\/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-DEV-[\w-]+\.story\.md$/; - This enforces relative paths under docs/stories/, numeric prefix, -DEV-, slug, and .story.md extension. - REQ-REQ-FORMAT: - Requirement IDs validated via: const reqPattern = /^REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+$/; - REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT: - collapseAnnotationValue(value: string): string { return value.replace(/\s+/g, ""); } - processComment() concatenates continuation lines into a single pending.value and then calls validateStoryAnnotation/validateReqAnnotation. - REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING: - normalizeCommentLine() trims and strips leading * for JSDoc, and preserves any @story/@req tags regardless of position on the line. - Comments can be line, block, or JSDoc style; annotations can appear anywhere in the comment text. - REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION: - processComment() detects @story/@req with regexes, tracks a PendingAnnotation, and finalizePending() dispatches to the correct validator, ensuring syntax is interpreted consistently before format checks. - REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY: - buildStoryErrorMessage(kind, value) and buildReqErrorMessage(kind, value) construct detailed, context-specific messages for missing vs invalid values, including the offending value and an example of the expected format. - These messages are wired into context.report() via messageId "invalidStoryFormat" and "invalidReqFormat" with a {{details}} placeholder. - REQ-PATH-FORMAT safety details: - getFixedStoryPath(original: string): string | null performs only conservative suffix normalization (.story → .story.md, .md → .story.md, or bare → .story.md) and explicitly skips paths containing ".."; so traversal paths are never auto-fixed and always reported as invalid. - Error handling and robustness: - processComment() copes with empty comment.value, empty lines, and comments without tags without throwing. - If auto-fix cannot safely locate the path substring inside the original comment, reportInvalidStoryFormatWithFix() falls back to a non-fixing report. - Rule export and ESLint integration: - src/index.ts includes "valid-annotation-format" in RULE_NAMES, dynamically loads it into the rules object, and includes "traceability/valid-annotation-format": "warn" in TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES. - configs.recommended and configs.strict both use createTraceabilityFlatConfig(), so this rule participates in the standard plugin configurations alongside require-story-annotation and require-branch-annotation, satisfying the integration requirement.
2) Tests specifically for this story - File: tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts - Test header explicitly targets this story and its requirements: /** * Tests for: docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md * @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md * @req REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION - Verify valid-annotation-format rule enforces annotation format syntax * Tests for: docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md * @story docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md * ... */ - Uses ESLint RuleTester, satisfying ESLint best-practice for rule validation: const ruleTester = new RuleTester({ languageOptions: { parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 2020 } } } as any); ruleTester.run("valid-annotation-format", rule, { valid: [...], invalid: [...] }); - Valid test cases cover: - [REQ-PATH-FORMAT] Single-line valid @story: `// @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md` - [REQ-REQ-FORMAT] Single-line valid @req: `// @req REQ-EXAMPLE` - [REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION] Paired @story/@req in block comment. - [REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT] Multi-line @story and multi-line @req in JSDoc comments; these ensure that the collapseAnnotationValue and processComment logic treats multi-line values as a single logical token. - [REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING] JSDoc-style comments with leading * and variable whitespace around tags and values. - Invalid test cases cover: - [REQ-PATH-FORMAT] - Missing story path: `// @story` and multi-line JSDoc `@story` with no value. - Invalid story file extension (".story" without .md) with auto-fix output asserting suffix normalization. - Missing extension entirely: `// @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION`, with output adding `.story.md`. - Path traversal using `../docs/...`, ensuring such values are reported as invalid and not auto-fixed. - [REQ-REQ-FORMAT] - Missing req id `// @req` or `// @req `. - Invalid ID `// @req invalid-format`. - Multi-line invalid ID (`REQ` split across lines into an invalid identifier after collapsing whitespace). - All invalid cases assert: - messageId is `invalidStoryFormat` or `invalidReqFormat` as appropriate. - data.details exactly matches the specific text from buildStoryErrorMessage/buildReqErrorMessage, including the offending value and the expected example, demonstrating error-message clarity and specificity.
3) Documentation for annotation format - File: docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md - Explicitly linked to this story and requirements: @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md @req REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION @req REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION @req REQ-PATH-FORMAT @req REQ-REQ-FORMAT - Documents: - The exact regex patterns enforced for @story and @req. - Multiline behavior: concatenation and whitespace removal for values spanning multiple lines. - Supported comment styles and flexible positioning of annotations. - Concrete correct/incorrect examples that align with the story’s example section.
4) Tests execution - Project test command from package.json: "test": "jest --ci --bail" - Invocations executed via tool: - npm test -- --runInBand --verbose - npm test -- --runInBand --verbose --testPathPatterns tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts - The incorrect use of --testPathPattern produced an explicit CLI error from Jest. After correcting to --testPathPatterns, Jest ran with no command failure reported by the tooling. The earlier plain `npm test` run also completed without an error. When Jest misconfiguration occurs, the tool surfaces a "Command failed" error; this did not occur for the final invocations, indicating the test suite (including valid-annotation-format.test.ts) executed successfully.
5) Integration with other rules - src/index.ts registers "valid-annotation-format" together with: - "require-story-annotation" (functions) - "require-req-annotation" - "require-branch-annotation" - reference-validation rules - The flat configs (recommended, strict) include these rules with appropriate severities, so when the plugin is used normally, the format rule runs alongside the function and branch rules. It validates syntax and format of the same annotations that those rules require, matching the story’s Integration acceptance criterion.
Overall, the implementation file, its dedicated tests, plugin wiring, and rule documentation directly implement and verify all listed requirements (REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY) for Story 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.
